overview: The **Product Details** drop-in emits product configuration and validation events, enabling real-time validation feedback and coordination with other storefront components.

product/data.description: Emitted when product data is loaded or updated. This includes product details, pricing, options, and availability information.

product.description: The complete product data structure including SKU, name, price, images, descriptions, and available options.

product/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during product operations such as loading product details or fetching option configurations.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which product operation failed.

product/initialized.description: Emitted when the product details component completes initialization. This indicates the product data is loaded and the component is ready to display product information.

product/options-selected.description: Emitted when a customer selects product options (such as size, color, or custom text). This event is useful for updating pricing, availability, or images based on the selected variant.

options.description: The currently selected product options including option UIDs and values.

selectedVariant.description: The specific product variant that matches the selected options, or `null` if no valid combination is selected.
